title: AvailabilityRequest
description: Availability lookup for a single product over a date range.

dateRange.description:
Both bounds are inclusive, and the range may span at most 92 days
counting both endpoints. `from` must not be after `to`. Violating
either rule returns `400`.

from.description: First day to report on, inclusive.

to.description: Last day to report on, inclusive. At most 91 days after `from`.
